elements.title: Python code example for training and testing a perceptron model on the Iris dataset
elements.details: Code snippet showing import statements from sklearn, loading Iris dataset (first 100 samples), splitting into train/test sets (25% test size), standardizing features, initializing and training a Perceptron model, making predictions, calculating accuracy, and printing the accuracy result (Accuracy: 1.0). Also includes a comment about using the trained perceptron to classify new data with an example input.
elements.summary: This code example demonstrates how to train a perceptron model on a subset of the Iris dataset for binary classification, evaluate its accuracy on a test set, and shows the resulting perfect accuracy output (1.0). It also introduces how to classify new data using the trained model.
